description: Call when Lode has no record for an app and platform you needed, or its facts were missing or out of date. Lode uses these requests to decide what to research next. If Lode already has the pair, the answer gives its id so you can call get_integration. Lode keeps only these fields (the app as a short cleaned name), the time, the kind of client and an anonymous caller code.

app.description: The app's name or website, e.g. "Katana" or "katanamrp.com"

ecosystem.description: Platform, e.g. "xero", "quickbooks-online", "hubspot", "shopify", "stripe", or another platform name

needs.description: Sync objects the buyer needed, e.g. ["invoices"]

reason.description: One of: not-covered, facts-missing, facts-outdated (default not-covered)

name: request_coverage
title: Request coverage
